risk_register.label: Data quality risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: data_foundations final_score=6.94 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will implement regular data quality checks on their Shopify platform to ensure that product information, customer details, and order history are accurate and up-to-date.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK GDPR Article 5(1)(d) — data accuracy principle
fashion_extensions_applied: Size and measurement data inconsistency across product lines prevents sizing AI from functioning reliably
Unstructured returns-reason data means Agent 2 recommendations for returns AI cannot be validated against real patterns

risk_register.label: Regulatory compliance risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: governance_compliance final_score=6.07 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will conduct a thorough review of their governance compliance policies to ensure they meet the required standards for data protection and consumer rights, particularly in relation to their use of Klaviyo marketing automation tools.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK GDPR 2018 — consent, data minimisation, subject access rights
fashion_extensions_applied: Personalisation profiling requires explicit consent — not implied by purchase history alone under UK GDPR
Automated pricing decisions may require human review disclosure under the UK AI Bill 2026

risk_register.label: Staff adoption risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: staff_digital_literacy final_score=6.34 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will provide regular training sessions for staff on digital literacy and Shopify platform usage to improve adoption rates and reduce the risk of errors or data breaches.
fashion_extensions_applied: Longer-serving retail staff may resist AI-assisted product recommendations if they perceive it as undermining their styling expertise
Owner-manager resistance is the single strongest predictor of failed AI adoption in fashion SMEs

risk_register.label: Vendor dependency risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will conduct a thorough vendor risk assessment for Klaviyo, including reviewing their security protocols and data handling practices to ensure they meet Lucy & Yak's standards for sustainability and brand authenticity.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 — data portability provisions
fashion_extensions_applied: Shopify platform dependency — significant portions of Agent 2 recommendations assume Shopify, creating risk if the business migrates platforms
Single marketing automation vendor lock-in — if Klaviyo is the only tool, all customer communication is at risk from a single vendor decision

risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will implement measures to prevent AI-generated content on their Shopify platform, including disabling chat widgets until a suitable provider is found that meets their brand standards and sustainability goals.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK AI Bill 2026 — accuracy and transparency obligations
fashion_extensions_applied: AI-generated size advice that is wrong drives returns rather than reducing them — directly counterproductive to the primary use case
AI-generated product descriptions containing incorrect material composition create trading standards liability

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will review and update their privacy policy to explicitly address the use of AI in their marketing efforts, ensuring transparency and compliance with relevant regulations.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Equality Act 2010 — protected characteristics in automated decision-making
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_yotpo
deliverables.content: To configure Yotpo for Lucy & Yak, navigate to the Shopify app store and install the Yotpo app. Within the app settings, select 'Reviews' as the primary feature and set up a review collection campaign using the automated post-purchase email sequence. Configure the review request timing to align with the item's likely wear date.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Lucy & Yak can leverage Yotpo's full-featured reviews and loyalty platform to scale their online sales while maintaining brand authenticity through its robust review management system.
Judge.me's lightweight and budget-friendly review collection app can help Lucy & Yak automate review collection without breaking the bank, aligning with their established tech budget.

While Trustpilot is a well-recognised review platform in the UK, its focus on trust signals may not directly address Lucy & Yak's primary challenge of maintaining brand authenticity and sustainable supply chain transparency.

roi_summary: Lucy & Yak can expect a 12-month commercial outcome of £1.35-£2.42 return per £1 spent, with key benefits delivered in phases: Automated Review Collection (Weeks 1) increases reviews by 3-5x; Returns Reason Capture (Weeks 1) reduces returns rates; Email Marketing Automation Flows (Weeks 2) delivers £36-£42 return per £1 spent; Size Guide Chatbot (Weeks 3) and WhatsApp Styling Assistant (Weeks 4) improve customer engagement; AI Demand Forecasting (Weeks 8) and Dynamic Pricing Engine (Weeks 8) optimize inventory and pricing, respectively.
